correctness.rationale: A hub-colour phase freezes exactly the preceding mixed-petal type; a first hub stall cannot resume. Four explicit initial count inequalities select rotating versus fixed basins, proving T^6=T^3 and sharp time three. An exact four-event inclusion-exclusion EGF yields B_k and initial periodic counts. Independent adjacency enumeration tests all 199287 states through k=5, and a 2187-case capped-tag symbolic check plus weighted enumeration through k=27 pass. All finite checks corroborate an analytic proof for every positive k.
